notes.title: Game release
notes.notes:
ITS RELEASE DAY!

There are some new events and secrets, saving, achievement and a few other changes since you've last played if you played the demo. 


I've been waiting for this moment for a long time. I hope you guys enjoying playing it as much as I enjoyed making it. If you encounter any bugs at all small or large feel free to put them in their own post or under this one. I'll be checking constantly and I'll try to get to any bug report as soon as possible. I don't have a playtest team or anything so I've just been playing the game repeatedly trying to get everything ready. I'm excited so I'm rambling sorry. I will stop now. Enjoy!

notes.title: Major Update 0.7.0
notes.notes:
- You can now build a church to worship one of three gods
- Water God allows you to summon tentacles to deal damage, summon a wave to push enemies back, and flood the battlefield to slow enemies down
- Fire god lights everything on fire
- Rock god helps with gold production and can hit all enemies present on the battlefield using rock spikes
- Sacrifice your citizens to gain favor with your god and upgrade your god's powers

- Added a tougher enemy when using auto clicker, not to punish auto clicker users but hopefully to make it more interesting to play with an auto clicker



Smaller Changes
- Fixed wizard shielding dead bodies
- Resolution Changer and Window mode added
- Buying personal trainer no longer says 0 skill points

notes.title: Build 0.5.8
notes.notes:
- Increased max number collected to 2 billion
- Updated the archer trainer and personal trainer to show how many days are left until you receive your 
   passive benefit, they also show how many times they have been upgraded
- Fixed sweeper not collecting health and gold
- Made "transmute damage to gold loss" slightly more clear (hopefully)
- Fixed a spelling error
- Changed skill point page buttons to match the other menus
- Fixed an issue with the pothole storyline affecting the revolutionary storyline unintentionally.

- Increased Orc Speed Slightly
- Changed Health Scaling So Enemies Are Tougher Later
- Added Wizard Enemy That Shields Other Enemies From Damage
- You Can Now Use "W" and "S" To Transition Between Top And Bottom Screen
- Fixed Wizard Upgrader Button Saying Archer
